steps.code:
import primitive_api as p

def brief(r):
    if isinstance(r, dict):
        print({k:r[k] for k in ("ok","valid_action","success","error","final_distance","progress","verification") if k in r})

b = p.detect_objects("SprayBottle")
print("visible bottles", len(b))
if b and not p.query_inventory():
    brief(p.pickup_object(b[0]["objectId"]))
print("inventory", p.query_inventory())

if p.query_inventory():
    r = p.place_held_object(
        "Toilet",
        aliases=["Toilet"],
        support_queries=["Bathroom"],
        search_budget=28
    )
    brief(r)
    print("put_attempts", r.get("put_attempts"))
print("final", p.check_success())
print("inventory_end", p.query_inventory())
print("pose", p.observe()["agent"])
